raw.query: WITH correction AS (SELECT static_encoder_workers_effective, binding_window_effective, static_as_ingested, binding_as_ingested FROM provenance.v_grid_static_effective), baseline AS (SELECT p.run_id, p.window_name, p.encoder_workers, d.n_replicas AS tp1_workers, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS p ON p.run_id = d.run_id CROSS JOIN correction AS c WHERE d.is_current AND p.is_current AND d.experiment = 'grid' AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND p.source_relation = 'llm_run_summary' AND p.run_id LIKE 'grid:grid_llm_%_aic' AND p.window_name = c.binding_window_effective AND p.encoder_workers = c.static_encoder_workers_effective AND d.tp IS NULL AND d.n_replicas IN (4, 8, 16)) SELECT c.static_as_ingested, c.binding_as_ingested, c.static_encoder_workers_effective, c.binding_window_effective, b.tp1_workers, b.p99_ms, b.n_requests, b.run_id FROM correction AS c JOIN baseline AS b ON true ORDER BY b.tp1_workers
raw.observed: Effective burst2/C8 grid: 4 workers = 1331.439922 ms, 8 = 1300.293230 ms, 16 = 1299.329853 ms; n_requests = 13870 each.
raw.claimed: TTFT p99 ~1.3 s from 4 through 16 TP1 workers on burst window.
raw.evidence: After applying the effective window/static correction, all three comparable grid points (4, 8, 16 workers) have TTFT p99 within 1.299-1.331 s on the same 13,870-request population.
